tagline: An old road the state let go and then took back.
intro: The Pequot Trail starts at Route 27 in Old Mystic and heads southeast across the middle of Stonington, and the scenic stretch runs about three miles of it to North Main Street. Past that it goes on toward Pawcatuck and US 1.

Its history is mostly paperwork. The state numbered it in 1932 as part of Route 84, moved Route 84 onto the Providence-New London Turnpike in 1935 and handed the trail back to the town. In 1963 the state took it over again as unsigned State Road 645, and in 1987 it became Route 234.

moments.title: Old Mystic
moments.text: The trail sets out from Old Mystic, a village shared between the towns of Groton and Stonington.

moments.title: Over Interstate 95
moments.text: About two and a half miles out the trail crosses over I-95 and carries on without so much as an intersection.
